name: macrame-cord-plan
description: Calculate cord cuts from measured knot take-up and folded attachment conventions.

interface.longDescription: Calculate cord cuts from measured knot take-up and folded attachment conventions. Includes calculate cuts with explicit fold convention; calibrate knot-role take-up; reconcile cut list against available cord. Measured knot take-up and attachment assumptions; no universal cord factor for every knot. Supplied inputs are transient; export documents to retain a copy. Navigation and conversation workspaces with three supplied-input operations. Real result files are available for explicit download. Supplied-input processing only; no accounts, payments, live retrieval or server-side history. For adults 18+.
defaultPrompt: Help me calculate cuts with explicit fold convention.

review.commerce_description: No payment, purchases, reservations, or generation-credit charges.
prompts:
I need to calculate cuts with explicit fold convention. Use these supplied inputs and the indicated units:
{"strands":8,"finished_cm":50,"takeup":4,"tails_cm":10,"attachment":"folded"}

I need to calibrate knot-role take-up. Use these supplied inputs and the indicated units:
{"samples":[{"role":"working","raw_consumed_cm":40,"finished_cm":10},{"role":"filler","raw_consumed_cm":11,"finished_cm":10}]}

I need to reconcile cut list against available cord. Use these supplied inputs and the indicated units:
{"cuts":[{"quantity":4,"length_cm":420}],"available_cm":2000}

positive.description: Calculate cuts with explicit fold convention using the supplied example; compare visible result to the returned values.
